description: Recently, a constituent asked me where I stand on the LEARNS Act and the Education Freedom Accounts (EFAs) that followed. It’s a fair and important question—one that many Arkansans are asking. At the heart of it, my response is this: I’m neither completely for nor completely against these policies. There are parts that I believe are positive steps forward, and others that raise serious concerns about the long-term impact on our public schools, our state budget, and our constitutional obligations

title: Protecting Public Education While Pursuing Reform
